# Taxonomies API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

Taxonomies are the shared controlled vocabularies: species, strains, anatomical regions and their atlas references, coordinate transforms, behavioral categories and paradigms, setup types and regulatory authorities. Changes by users without approval rights become approval requests.

## Resources

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`species`](/api/taxonomies/species/) | The shared list of species subjects can belong to. | private, public |
| [`strain`](/api/taxonomies/strain/) | The shared list of strains, each belonging to a species. | private, public |
| [`anatomicalregion`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/) | The shared atlas of brain regions that procedures and recordings point to. | private, public |
| [`anatomicalreference`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/) | Immutable, system-managed anatomical atlas release metadata. | private, public |
| [`coordinatetransform`](/api/taxonomies/coordinatetransform/) | Named, versioned mapping from a BrainSTEM coordinate type to an atlas. | private, public |
| [`behavioralcategory`](/api/taxonomies/behavioralcategory/) | A shared two-level grouping of behavioral paradigms by cognitive domain. | private, public |
| [`behavioralparadigm`](/api/taxonomies/behavioralparadigm/) | A standard behavioral task shared across labs, independent of how one lab runs it. | private, public |
| [`setuptype`](/api/taxonomies/setuptype/) | A shared classification of experimental preparations, such as head-fixed or freely moving. | private, public |
| [`regulatoryauthority`](/api/taxonomies/regulatoryauthority/) | The shared list of organizations that issue research licenses. | private, public |

## Supporting endpoints

Approval requests, membership invitations and link tables. Most workflows never call these directly; the main resources create and resolve them.

| Resource | What it is | Portals |
|:---------|:-----------|:--------|
| [`behavioralcategoryapproval`](/api/taxonomies/behavioralcategoryapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared behavioral category, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |
| [`behavioralparadigmapproval`](/api/taxonomies/behavioralparadigmapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared behavioral paradigm, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |
| [`regulatoryauthorityapproval`](/api/taxonomies/regulatoryauthorityapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared regulatory authority, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |
| [`setuptypeapproval`](/api/taxonomies/setuptypeapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared setup type, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |
| [`speciesapproval`](/api/taxonomies/speciesapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared species, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |
| [`strainapproval`](/api/taxonomies/strainapproval/) | A request to add or change a shared strain, reviewed before it takes effect. | private |

All endpoints follow `https://www.brainstem.org/api/{portal}/taxonomies/{resource}/` and support the common [query parameters](/api/#query-parameters).
